### Data prep and split
```{r}
#load dataset:
#150cm:
pedon_pack_150_p <- read.csv("../outputs/pedon_pack_150_03_05_2026.csv")

set.seed(1)

df <- pedon_pack_150_p %>%
  mutate(
    peiid = as.character(peiid),
    taxorder = factor(taxorder)
  )

# lump rare orders to avoid dropped-level issues in resampling
min_n <- 15
df <- df %>%
  mutate(taxorder = fct_lump_min(taxorder, min = min_n, other_level = "Other"))
#there is only 4 lol...
count(df, taxorder, sort = TRUE)

df <- df %>% filter(taxorder != "Other")
df <- df %>% droplevels()
count(df, taxorder, sort = TRUE)

split <- initial_split(df, prop = 0.8, strata = taxorder)
train <- training(split)
test  <- testing(split)
```

#Taxorder:

### Recipe:

```{r}
make_tax_recipe <- function(train, outcome) {

  tax_cols <- names(train)[stringr::str_detect(names(train), "^tax")]
  tax_rm   <- setdiff(tax_cols, outcome)

  cec_cols <- intersect(
    c("cec7_w", "pct_hz_with_cec7", "min_cec_per_kg_clay_0_150", "median_cec_per_kg_clay_bt_zone"),
    names(train)
  )

  log_cols <- intersect(
    c("sandy_mantle_cm",
      "plinthite_thickness_cm", "plinthite_overlap_0_150_cm",
      "bt_thickness_cm", "argillic_thickness_cm", "argillic_contiguous_max_cm"),
    names(train)
  )

  # ---- KEY FIX: leakage list but never remove the outcome ----
  leakage_rm <- c(
    "taxonname_clean", "taxonname_key", "taxclname",
    "taxsubgrp", "taxsubgrp_clean",
    "taxsubgrp_mod1", "taxsubgrp_mod2", "taxsubgrp_mod3",
    "taxsubgrp_mod_group", "taxgrtgroup_mod_group", "taxsuborder_mod_group"
  )
  leakage_rm <- setdiff(leakage_rm, outcome)

  rec <- recipe(stats::as.formula(paste(outcome, "~ .")), data = train) %>%
    update_role(peiid, new_role = "id") %>%

    step_rm(any_of(leakage_rm)) %>%
    step_rm(any_of(tax_rm)) %>%
    step_rm(starts_with("mod_"), starts_with("is_")) %>%

    step_string2factor(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
    step_unknown(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
    step_other(all_nominal_predictors(), threshold = 0.01)

  if (length(cec_cols) > 0) {
    rec <- rec %>% step_indicate_na(all_of(cec_cols), prefix = "na2")
  }

  rec <- rec %>%
    step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
    step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
    step_impute_median(all_numeric_predictors())

  if (length(log_cols) > 0) {
    clamp_exprs <- rlang::set_names(
      lapply(log_cols, function(nm) rlang::expr(pmax(.data[[!!nm]], 0))),
      log_cols
    )

    rec <- rec %>%
      step_mutate(!!!clamp_exprs) %>%
      step_log(all_of(log_cols), offset = 1)
  }

  rec %>%
    step_zv(all_predictors()) %>%
    step_normalize(all_numeric_predictors())
}

```

### Bake:
```{r}
bake_xy <- function(train, test, outcome) {
  rec <- make_tax_recipe(train, outcome)
  prep_rec <- prep(rec, training = train)

  x_train <- bake(prep_rec, new_data = train) %>% select(-all_of(outcome), -peiid)
  x_test  <- bake(prep_rec, new_data = test)  %>% select(-all_of(outcome), -peiid)

  y_train <- train[[outcome]]
  y_test  <- test[[outcome]]

  # UMAP safety (no NA/Inf)
  x_train <- x_train %>% mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.finite(.x), .x, NA_real_)))
  x_test  <- x_test  %>% mutate(across(everything(), ~ ifelse(is.finite(.x), .x, NA_real_)))
  x_train[is.na(x_train)] <- 0
  x_test[is.na(x_test)] <- 0

  list(prep = prep_rec, x_train = x_train, x_test = x_test, y_train = y_train, y_test = y_test)
}
```

### UMAP:

```{r}
make_umap_sets <- function(x_train, x_test, y_train, y_test,
                           n_components = 10, n_neighbors = 15, min_dist = 0.1,
                           minPts = 10, add_hdb = TRUE, seed = 2) {

  set.seed(seed)
  umap_fit <- uwot::umap(
    as.matrix(x_train),
    n_components = n_components,
    n_neighbors = n_neighbors,
    min_dist = min_dist,
    metric = "euclidean",
    ret_model = TRUE
  )

  z_train <- as.data.frame(umap_fit$embedding)
  names(z_train) <- paste0("U", seq_len(ncol(z_train)))

  z_test <- as.data.frame(uwot::umap_transform(as.matrix(x_test), umap_fit))
  names(z_test) <- names(z_train)

  train_umap <- bind_cols(z_train, outcome = y_train)
  test_umap  <- bind_cols(z_test,  outcome = y_test)

  if (!add_hdb) {
    return(list(plain = list(train = train_umap, test = test_umap), umap_fit = umap_fit))
  }

  # HDBSCAN on UMAP space
  hdb_fit <- dbscan::hdbscan(as.matrix(z_train), minPts = minPts)
  test_cluster <- predict(hdb_fit, newdata = as.matrix(z_test), data = as.matrix(z_train))
  levs <- sort(unique(c(hdb_fit$cluster, test_cluster)))

  train_hdb <- train_umap %>%
    mutate(
      hdb_cluster = factor(hdb_fit$cluster, levels = levs),
      hdb_noise   = factor(if_else(hdb_fit$cluster == 0, "noise", "cluster"),
                           levels = c("cluster", "noise"))
    )

  test_hdb <- test_umap %>%
    mutate(
      hdb_cluster = factor(test_cluster, levels = levs),
      hdb_noise   = factor(if_else(test_cluster == 0, "noise", "cluster"),
                           levels = c("cluster", "noise"))
    )

  list(
    plain = list(train = train_umap, test = test_umap),
    hdb   = list(train = train_hdb,  test = test_hdb),
    umap_fit = umap_fit,
    hdb_fit  = hdb_fit
  )
}
```

### RF or XGBOOST:

```{r}
fit_rf <- function(train_dat, test_dat, trees = 1200, seed = 1) {
  set.seed(seed)

  train_dat <- train_dat %>% rename(y = outcome)
  test_dat  <- test_dat  %>% rename(y = outcome)

  v <- min(5, min(count(train_dat, y)$n))
  folds <- vfold_cv(train_dat, v = v, strata = y)

  rf_spec <- rand_forest(trees = trees, mtry = tune(), min_n = tune()) %>%
    set_engine("ranger", probability = TRUE, importance = "permutation") %>%
    set_mode("classification")

  wf <- workflow() %>% add_model(rf_spec) %>% add_formula(y ~ .)

  p <- ncol(train_dat) - 1
  grid <- grid_regular(
    mtry(range = c(2, min(12, p))),
    min_n(range = c(2, 25)),
    levels = 4
  )

  tuned <- tune_grid(wf, resamples = folds, grid = grid,
                     metrics = metric_set(accuracy, kap, bal_accuracy))

  best <- select_best(tuned, metric = "bal_accuracy")
  final_fit <- finalize_workflow(wf, best) %>% fit(train_dat)

  pred <- predict(final_fit, test_dat, type = "prob") %>%
    bind_cols(predict(final_fit, test_dat, type = "class")) %>%
    bind_cols(test_dat %>% select(y))

  list(fit = final_fit, tuned = tuned, best = best, pred = pred)
}
```

### plain XGBOOST:

```{r}
fit_xgb <- function(train_dat, test_dat, seed = 1) {
  set.seed(seed)

  train_dat <- train_dat %>% rename(y = outcome)
  test_dat  <- test_dat  %>% rename(y = outcome)

  v <- min(5, min(count(train_dat, y)$n))
  folds <- vfold_cv(train_dat, v = v, strata = y)

  xgb_spec <- boost_tree(
    trees = tune(),
    tree_depth = tune(),
    learn_rate = tune(),
    min_n = tune(),
    loss_reduction = tune(),
    sample_size = tune(),
    mtry = tune()
  ) %>%
    set_engine("xgboost") %>%
    set_mode("classification")

  wf <- workflow() %>% add_model(xgb_spec) %>% add_formula(y ~ .)

  p <- ncol(train_dat) - 1
  grid <- grid_space_filling(
    trees(range = c(200L, 2000L)),
    tree_depth(),
    learn_rate(range = c(-4, -1)),   # log10 scale
    min_n(),
    loss_reduction(),
    sample_size = sample_prop(),
    mtry(range = c(2L, min(30L, p))),
    size = 30
  )

  tuned <- tune_grid(
    wf, resamples = folds, grid = grid,
    metrics = metric_set(accuracy, kap, bal_accuracy)
  )

  best <- select_best(tuned, metric = "bal_accuracy")
  final_fit <- finalize_workflow(wf, best) %>% fit(train_dat)

  pred <- predict(final_fit, test_dat, type = "prob") %>%
    bind_cols(predict(final_fit, test_dat, type = "class")) %>%
    bind_cols(test_dat %>% select(y))

  list(fit = final_fit, tuned = tuned, best = best, pred = pred)
}
```

### RUN


```{r}
run_all_models_one_outcome <- function(train, test, outcome_name, min_n = 10) {

  stopifnot(outcome_name %in% names(train), outcome_name %in% names(test))

  train2 <- train %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[outcome_name]])) %>%
    mutate(!!outcome_name := factor(.data[[outcome_name]])) %>%
    mutate(!!outcome_name := forcats::fct_lump_min(.data[[outcome_name]], min = min_n, other_level = "Other")) %>%
    filter(.data[[outcome_name]] != "Other") %>%
    droplevels()

  test2 <- test %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[outcome_name]])) %>%
    mutate(!!outcome_name := factor(.data[[outcome_name]], levels = levels(train2[[outcome_name]]))) %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[outcome_name]])) %>%  # drop outcomes not in train after lumping
    droplevels()

  baked <- bake_xy(train2, test2, outcome_name)

  train_plain <- dplyr::bind_cols(baked$x_train, outcome = baked$y_train)
  test_plain  <- dplyr::bind_cols(baked$x_test,  outcome = baked$y_test)

  um <- make_umap_sets(
    baked$x_train, baked$x_test, baked$y_train, baked$y_test,
    n_components = 10, n_neighbors = 15, min_dist = 0.1,
    minPts = 10, add_hdb = TRUE
  )

  fits <- list(
    rf_plain      = fit_rf(train_plain, test_plain, seed = 1),
    xgb_plain     = fit_xgb(train_plain, test_plain, seed = 1),
    rf_umap       = fit_rf(um$plain$train, um$plain$test, seed = 1),
    xgb_umap      = fit_xgb(um$plain$train, um$plain$test, seed = 1),
    rf_umap_hdb   = fit_rf(um$hdb$train, um$hdb$test, seed = 1),
    xgb_umap_hdb  = fit_xgb(um$hdb$train, um$hdb$test, seed = 1)
  )

  metric_fn <- function(pred_tbl, model_name) {
    pred_tbl <- pred_tbl %>% rename(truth = y)
    tibble(
      outcome = outcome_name,
      model = model_name,
      accuracy = yardstick::accuracy(pred_tbl, truth = truth, estimate = .pred_class)$.estimate,
      kap = yardstick::kap(pred_tbl, truth = truth, estimate = .pred_class)$.estimate,
      bal_accuracy = yardstick::bal_accuracy(pred_tbl, truth = truth, estimate = .pred_class)$.estimate,
      f_meas_macro = yardstick::f_meas(pred_tbl, truth = truth, estimate = .pred_class, estimator = "macro")$.estimate
    )
  }

  metrics <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    metric_fn(fits$rf_plain$pred, "RF_plain"),
    metric_fn(fits$xgb_plain$pred, "XGB_plain"),
    metric_fn(fits$rf_umap$pred, "RF_umap"),
    metric_fn(fits$xgb_umap$pred, "XGB_umap"),
    metric_fn(fits$rf_umap_hdb$pred, "RF_umap_hdb"),
    metric_fn(fits$xgb_umap_hdb$pred, "XGB_umap_hdb")
  )

  list(fits = fits, metrics = metrics)
}
```

```{r}
# 2) extract VI table from a tidymodels workflow fit
get_vi_tbl <- function(fit_obj, top_n = 25) {
  wf <- fit_obj$fit
  eng <- workflows::extract_fit_engine(wf)

  if (inherits(eng, "ranger")) {
    vi <- eng$variable.importance
    tibble(
      Variable = names(vi),
      Importance = as.numeric(vi)
    ) %>%
      arrange(desc(Importance)) %>%
      slice_head(n = top_n)
  } else if (inherits(eng, "xgb.Booster")) {
    imp <- xgboost::xgb.importance(model = eng)
    tibble(
      Variable = imp$Feature,
      Importance = imp$Gain
    ) %>%
      arrange(desc(Importance)) %>%
      slice_head(n = top_n)
  } else {
    stop("Unknown engine: ", paste(class(eng), collapse = ", "))
  }
}

# 3) build VIP tables + plots
vip_tables_plain <- list()
vip_plots_plain  <- list()

for (k in seq_len(nrow(best_plain_by_outcome))) {
  oc <- best_plain_by_outcome$outcome[k]
  md <- best_plain_by_outcome$model[k]
  i  <- run_lookup[[oc]]

  fit_key <- if (md == "RF_plain") "rf_plain" else "xgb_plain"
  fit_obj <- all_runs[[i]]$fits[[fit_key]]

  vi_tbl <- get_vi_tbl(fit_obj, top_n = 25)
  vip_tables_plain[[oc]] <- vi_tbl

  vip_plots_plain[[oc]] <- vi_tbl %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = reorder(Variable, Importance), y = Importance)) +
    geom_col() +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      title = paste0("VIP (plain): ", oc, " — ", md),
      x = NULL, y = "Importance"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
}
```

```{r}
# Across taxonomic levels, the most consistently important predictors reflect subsoil development and particle-size organization: the thickness and depth of Bt/argillic-like zones and the overall texture (clay/silt/sand) across 0–150 cm. Secondary but high-leverage predictors capture sandy mantles (coarse-over-fine profiles) and wetness/redox expression (gleyed horizons). Together, these features summarize key pedogenic controls—illuviation intensity, parent material texture/stratification, and drainage—that Soil Taxonomy uses to differentiate taxa.
```

```{r}
fit_key_from_model <- function(model) {
  dplyr::case_when(
    model == "RF_plain"     ~ "rf_plain",
    model == "RF_umap"      ~ "rf_umap",
    model == "RF_umap_hdb"  ~ "rf_umap_hdb",
    model == "XGB_plain"    ~ "xgb_plain",
    model == "XGB_umap"     ~ "xgb_umap",
    model == "XGB_umap_hdb" ~ "xgb_umap_hdb",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )
}

per_class_from_counts <- function(pred_tbl) {
  # pred_tbl must have columns: truth, .pred_class
  counts <- pred_tbl %>%
    dplyr::count(truth, .pred_class, name = "n")

  truth_tot <- counts %>%
    dplyr::group_by(truth) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(support = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::rename(class = truth)

  pred_tot <- counts %>%
    dplyr::group_by(.pred_class) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(pred_n = sum(n), .groups = "drop") %>%
    dplyr::rename(class = .pred_class)

  tp <- counts %>%
    dplyr::filter(truth == .pred_class) %>%
    dplyr::transmute(class = truth, tp = n)

  truth_tot %>%
    dplyr::left_join(pred_tot, by = "class") %>%
    dplyr::left_join(tp, by = "class") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      tp = dplyr::coalesce(tp, 0L),
      pred_n = dplyr::coalesce(pred_n, 0L),
      recall = ifelse(support > 0, tp / support, NA_real_),
      precision = ifelse(pred_n > 0, tp / pred_n, NA_real_)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(support))
}

report_one <- function(outcome_name) {

  b <- best_by_outcome %>%
    dplyr::filter(outcome == outcome_name) %>%
    dplyr::slice(1)

  if (nrow(b) == 0) stop("Outcome not found in best_by_outcome: ", outcome_name)

  model_name <- b$model[[1]]
  fit_key <- fit_key_from_model(model_name)
  if (is.na(fit_key)) stop("No fit key for model: ", model_name)

  i <- run_lookup[[outcome_name]]
  if (is.null(i)) stop("Outcome not found in outcomes/run_lookup: ", outcome_name)

  pred_tbl <- all_runs[[i]]$fits[[fit_key]]$pred %>%
    dplyr::rename(truth = y)

  overall <- tibble::tibble(
    outcome = outcome_name,
    model = model_name,
    acc = yardstick::accuracy(pred_tbl, truth = truth, estimate = .pred_class)$.estimate,
    bal_acc = yardstick::bal_accuracy(pred_tbl, truth = truth, estimate = .pred_class)$.estimate,
    kap = yardstick::kap(pred_tbl, truth = truth, estimate = .pred_class)$.estimate,
    f1_macro = yardstick::f_meas(pred_tbl, truth = truth, estimate = .pred_class, estimator = "macro")$.estimate
  )

  per_class <- per_class_from_counts(pred_tbl)

  top_conf <- pred_tbl %>%
    dplyr::count(truth, .pred_class, name = "n") %>%
    dplyr::group_by(truth) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(p = n / sum(n)) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::filter(truth != .pred_class) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n)) %>%
    dplyr::slice_head(n = 15)

  list(overall = overall, per_class = per_class, top_conf = top_conf)
}

reports <- purrr::set_names(purrr::map(targets, report_one), targets)

#Thresholds on continuous processes
# Wetness (Aquic) and sandy mantle thickness (Arenic/Grossarenic) are gradients. When expression is subtle or near boundaries, the model flips categories—especially toward defaults (Typic).
# 
# Depth-window / incomplete profile representation (0–150 cm)
# When key diagnostic horizons are deep, thin, or not well captured in measured horizons, models drift toward “less developed” categories (Entisols) and muddle development intensity boundaries.
# 
# Control-section definitions vs summary predictors
# Family particle-size is rule-based on a defined control section; your summaries approximate it but blur boundaries—leading to adjacent-class errors.
```
